subject: Second clip handoff on Ziggy's request: "The signal" (L19 S3 worm versus harvester, Grok 500 looks); viewed at full size, L4 S5 with the drift recorded; order after the rise; a third candidate (L07 S4 the mirror burst) seen, not yet a handoff
body:
Ziggy, in the session at about 01:50 UTC, showed the Visual library's L19 "S3 worm vs harvester" frame and asked that it be woven into the test as well. The handoff is attached: SECOND_CLIP_HANDOFF_20261014.md, sha256 6c9a4a6ae8a77f8bfafeff0b2dae4a3a659b4a0de1633ce7c07660833dc4e5ad, 6,020 bytes; same lane, same rules as the first.

Source: grok_500_20261008/received/content/LAG-500-MASTER-part03/LAG-L19-fire-trial-armor.zip.contents/LAG-L19-fire-trial-armor/LAG-L19-fire-trial-armor__S3-worm-vs-harvester.jpg, sha256 b26aa61a04528cd8c3ef820ccc946e74738db634f29aed018286c138efd8bb09, 388,976 bytes, 1280 by 720; ledger id LAG500-L19-S3, role story_scene_study, localReviewStatus unreviewed (unchanged by this); Grok's intake QA: breather on, piercings mirrored, kept; a Grok hero candidate, not a user favorite or approved reference. Viewed by me at full size, reviewer claude, L4 S5 preliminary: the AL, the vertical GAIB, the two segmented worms facing the eye in the disc and the blue eyes all present; drift recorded as inherited: the breather on his LEFT cheek (mirrored), two ear hoops and the brow ring on his RIGHT, the nostril hoop on his left, the fire-trial armour look rather than the suit-and-cloak lock.

Shot: the worm closes over a raiders' rig behind him while he holds one hand raised, eyes on the lens, breather in place; end state the rig gone, the maw closing, the dust settling, he unchanged. Locked camera, eye height, medium close. Light as sources: the warm overcast haze as key; the fire at screen-right as the one permitted second emitter, flickering on the rig, the worm's lip and the dust and only faintly on his far cheek. Native length per route, 16:9, silent prompt, audio recorded. Checks add the breather's known failure modes (same cheek, one tube, no mirroring or duplication, no rear connector) and the hand (raised, five fingers, no second hand). Order: the rise first (one emitter), the signal second (two), so the second test adds one variable; if Ziggy wants the order reversed nothing else changes. The library's caption names the rig by the franchise's word; the handoff says "the rig", and the worm-and-rig imagery sits under open item 8 (Ziggy's IP call beyond the test).

He then showed L07 "S4 breaking out" (the mirror burst into the desert night, the camp at the fire): the two-worlds spine in one frame and a natural third candidate, but a harder clip (glass, slow motion, many moving pieces) and Grok's QA already notes the AL garbled into another glyph. I am looking at it at full size now; no handoff for it yet. The site shows his review request for it queued for Gemini and Flow, not sent.
